_comment: Free-tier limits copied from the AI Studio rate-limit page (2026-09-23). Each model has its OWN daily bucket. 'display' is the AI Studio name and is used to look up the real API id via models.list(); 'id' is the fallback if the lookup fails. Quotas reset at midnight Pacific. routing lists, per task, which models to try in order. OpenRouter entries use 'pick' (preferred name fragments) instead of a fixed id, because the ':free' list changes; 'providers' holds account-wide limits (OpenRouter: 50 free requests/day, 1000 after a lifetime $10 top-up; gemini_pool asks OpenRouter which applies at startup). OpenRouter's per-minute free limit (~20) is shared by the account, so the two entries' rpm add up to less than it.

routing._comment: outline = era plans and overviews (few calls, best models); draft = event and entity pages (bulk); classify = RSS articles; verify = judge drafted claims against Wikipedia extracts (Gemini 2.5, the only free search-grounded models, is closed to new users); the largest free OpenRouter models first, because a 2026-09-28 audit found Gemma too generous. translate = Traditional Chinese versions: Chinese-native OpenRouter free models first, then Gemma. video_text = summarise a video's own subtitles (text only, cheap). video = watch YouTube videos linked from RSS posts when there are no subtitles, or to compare with the subtitle summary (Gemini only; ~100 tokens/s at low resolution, so a 250K TPM model is needed). vision = read photos (Gemma first: large quota; a model that cannot take images is skipped per call). evidence = judge which archive/scholarly search results really relate to a page (the largest free OpenRouter models first: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, then Super 120B; Gemma only as fallback). classify and video_text end with OpenRouter, so RSS articles are still classified and subtitles summarised when Google is unavailable (Google key rejected from 2026-09-30). source_first_compare = the v2.1 source-first experiment's comparison model only: another family than Nemotron ('avoid'; '*' takes the largest free model left when no preference matches), resolved after Large and Medium so it is never the same model; rpm 1 keeps the three entries under the account-wide limit; no pipeline step uses it. fact_extraction_trial = the v2.2 model scoring only (scripts/score_extraction_models.py): every candidate for the single-question extraction steps, each forced in turn with only=[model]; no pipeline step uses it. The trial-only entries (Lightning, Dots, Laguna) were added 2026-10-16 when Nemotron 3 Ultra's free endpoint began answering 404; Inkling was dropped the same day: OpenRouter serves its free copy only to agentic harnesses (403). They are listed at rpm 1 (Large and Medium lowered to 7) so the account-wide limit holds, and a trial raises the model under test to TRIAL_RPM.
